title: 第三章 绝境硬刚，一刀镇军心
slug: 穿越戍边我从炮灰辅卒一路封王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

狂风卷着暴雪，狠狠拍在黑石堡残破的土墙上。

冰冷的杀机笼罩整座戍堡，压得所有人喘不过气。

方才苏烬的嘶吼还回荡在墙头，可慌乱的士卒根本听不进去。

三四名小兵翻过矮墙，踩着没过脚踝的厚雪，拼命往后山荒原狂奔。

在他们眼里，守在破堡里是坐以待毙，冲进雪原，或许还能搏出一条生路。

但他们根本不懂黑羯的打法。

草原骑兵最擅长的就是追杀逃兵。

步兵在空旷雪原跑路，脚步再快，也跑不过四条腿的战马。

他们自以为的生路，其实是送命的死路。

“都回来！不许逃！”

刘屯将扯着沙哑的嗓子大喊，声音嘶哑无力。

他在位五年，早就没有任何威信。乱世边关，军法形同虚设，生死面前，没人会听一个无能屯将的空话。

周疤子站在墙头，脸色青一阵白一阵，心底的逃意越来越浓。

守，大概率要死。

逃，说不定还有一线生机。

就在整道防线濒临溃散、所有人心态崩盘的时候，一道冷静又强硬的声音，压过漫天风雪，死死按住了混乱的局面。

“所有人原地站住！贴墙死守！”

“木盾在前，长棍长矛在后，卡死墙垛和缺口！”

“逃跑必死！留下来，才有活路！”

说话的是苏烬。

他胸口断骨撕裂般疼痛，风寒高烧让头脑阵阵发昏，嘴角血丝不断溢出，身体早已到了透支的边缘。

可他身姿依旧挺拔，眼神冷得吓人。

前世无数次绝境厮杀的经验，让他看得比所有人都通透。

黑羯三十骑正面佯攻，目的不是破堡，是攻心。

他们就是要吓慌守军，逼所有人溃逃，再让暗处伏兵合围屠杀。

越是慌乱逃窜，死得越快。

只有依托残破土墙固守，卡住地形优势，拖到风雪加剧、拖到援军抵近，才能杀出一线生机。

“你个新兵蛋子也敢指挥人？找死！”

周疤子瞬间怒目圆睁，满心不服。

往日任由自己拿捏的软蛋，如今竟敢当众压他一头。

几个准备跳墙的士卒也回头怒骂：“守在这里就是等死，凭什么拦我们！”

绝境之中，争执毫无意义。

苏烬懒得废话，目光快速扫过整面堡墙，锁定西侧墙体。

那里坍塌出一丈多宽的巨大缺口，没有士卒把守、没有遮挡，是整座戍堡最致命的破绽。

一旦羯兵从这里突入，内外夹击，所有人都要葬身堡中。

“陈石头！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The strong wind whipped up the blizzard, slamming against the broken earth walls of Blackstone Castle.

The cold murderous intent enveloped the entire fort, making everyone breathless.

Su Jin's roar just now was still echoing on the wall, but the panicked soldiers couldn't listen at all.

Three or four soldiers climbed over the low wall, stepped on the thick snow up to their ankles, and ran as hard as they could toward the wilderness of the back mountain.

In their eyes, staying in the dilapidated fortress means waiting for death. If they rush into the snowfield, they may still be able to find a way out.

But they don’t understand Black Capricorn’s style of play at all.

What the prairie cavalry is best at is chasing down deserters.

The infantry was running in the open snowy field. No matter how fast they walked, they could not outrun the four-legged war horses.

What they thought was a way to survive was actually a way to die.

"Everyone come back! Don't run away!"

General Liu Tun shouted with a hoarse voice, his voice hoarse and weak.

He has been in office for five years and has long lost any authority.In troubled times at the border, military law is in name only. In the face of life and death, no one will listen to the empty words of an incompetent general.

Zhou Scarzi stood on the wall, his face turning blue and white, and the desire to escape in his heart became stronger and stronger.

If you keep it, you will most likely die.

Escape, maybe there is still a chance of survival.

Just when the entire line of defense was on the verge of collapse and everyone's mentality collapsed, a calm and strong voice overcame the wind and snow, firmly holding down the chaotic situation.

"Everyone, stop where you are! Stick to the wall and defend!"

"Wooden shield in front, long stick and spear behind, block the wall stacks and gaps!"

"If you run away, you will die! If you stay, you will have a way to survive!"

It was Su Jin who spoke.

The pain in his chest was like a broken bone. The cold and high fever made his head dizzy. Bloodshot eyes kept flowing from the corners of his mouth. His body was already on the verge of overdraft.

But his posture was still upright, and his eyes were frighteningly cold.

The experience of countless desperate battles in his previous life allowed him to see more clearly than anyone else.

The Thirty Black Jie cavalry feigned a frontal attack, their purpose was not to break the fortress but to attack the heart.

They just want to scare the defenders, force everyone to flee, and then let the ambushes in the dark surround and massacre them.

The more you panic and run away, the faster you will die.

Only by relying on the dilapidated earth walls to hold on, holding on to the advantage of the terrain, until the wind and snow intensifies, and until reinforcements arrive, can we get a glimmer of hope.

"How dare you, a new recruit, command others? You're looking for death!"

Zhou Scarzi's eyes suddenly widened with anger, full of dissatisfaction.

The soft guy who used to be at his mercy now dared to bully him in public.

Several soldiers who were about to jump over the wall also turned around and cursed angrily: "If you stay here, you are waiting to die. Why should you stop us!"

In a desperate situation, there is no point in arguing.

Su Jin was too lazy to talk nonsense, and quickly scanned the entire fort wall, focusing on the west wall.

A huge gap more than ten feet wide collapsed there. It was unguarded and unshielded by soldiers. It was the most fatal flaw in the entire fort.

Once the Jie soldiers break in from here and attack from inside and outside, everyone will be buried in the fort.

"Chen Shitou!"
